topic: Three things that move digital miner rewards
hook: Three things move your digital miner's results, and you control none.

scenes.narration: First, the bitcoin price. Rewards and maintenance fees both vary with it.
Second, network difficulty, which is adjusted every two thousand sixteen blocks.
Third, total network hashrate. Net results can be low or even negative.

cta: Which one worries you most? Tell me in the comments, and the link is on my channel page.
title: 3 Things That Move Your Digital Miner Results
description_body: Price, difficulty and network hashrate all change digital miner results.
